name: LC1

load.source: SimJEB 148.fem FORCE 2 on node 129265 (8,000 lbf vertical)

pin_model.freecad: Rigid Body Constraint on pin_bore_pos_y and pin_bore_neg_y; reference node at applied_at; translations x, y, z in Load mode with the vector's components; rotations Free
pin_model.written_as: *RIGID BODY with REF NODE; the vector is one CLOAD on the reference node
pin_model.rejected: half_bore: Force on the upper half of each bore (splits the bore faces; FreeCAD writes 0.118 % less force than declared)

support.model: FreeCAD Fixed on each bolt-hole face: every node on the hole held in all DOF, as SimJEB's RBE2 spiders with SPC 123456

zone.about: each bolt axis, in plan, full height (the boss lobe)
zone.why: fixed hole faces are a stress singularity: the peak on a hole edge moves between holes and does not converge with refinement

region_scoring_zone.about: each bolt axis, in plan, full height
region_scoring_zone.used_by: the region label a vision claim is scored against (D-06, D-07 region hit) - never the stress check, which keeps the 10 mm zone
region_scoring_zone.why: owner, 2026-09-22 (M2.7): between 10 and 25 mm the governing peak is the underside pocket wall beside a fixed bolt. It converges, so the stress check keeps it, but it reads as part of the bolt-hole field on the contour. Beyond 25 mm the governing region is arm_root_fillet (docs/m2-exchange.md section 4)

material.name: Ti-6Al-4V
material.source: E, nu, rho from SimJEB 148.fem MAT1; yield 131 ksi set by the challenge

displacement_limit.measured: rigid pin model, FemMeshGmsh 2nd order, HighOrderOptimize Optimization, max 4 mm, min 1 mm; re-measure when M2.3 freezes D-24 sizing

mutant_wrong_direction.note: D-16: LC1 with the sign flipped

stress_check.quantity: max nodal von Mises outside the support zone
stress_check.also_report: raw max von Mises and its location, flagged as the support singularity

model_extent_why: D-23 does not hold: the SimJEB bolt pattern is not symmetric about the clevis midplane (ge-bracket-part.md section 7)
